modes.definition_zh: 在思想领域打破陈旧的教条和束缚，主张思想的自由探索和创新。通过批判传统权威的思想垄断，实现人的思维自由化，为新的思维模式的产生创造空间。
modes.definition_en: Break through outdated dogmas and constraints in the realm of thought, advocating for free exploration and innovation of thought. By critiquing traditional authorities' intellectual monopoly, realize human cognitive freedom, creating space for new thinking modes to emerge.
process_zh: 识别思想束缚的来源和表现
批判陈旧的教条和权威
开放思维空间让新观点产生
验证新思维模式的有效性
process_en: Identify sources and manifestations of intellectual constraints
Critique outdated dogmas and authorities
Open thinking space for new ideas to emerge
Verify effectiveness of new thinking modes
modern_applications: 大学思维自由环境建设
创新研究的自由保障机制

modes.domain_zh: 中国革命历史的辩证分析
modes.domain_en: Dialectical Analysis of Chinese Revolutionary History
modes.definition_zh: 运用辩证法观察中国革命历史的发展规律，统一对革命历史的肯定与批判，从具体实践中提炼出具有普遍意义的历史规律。
modes.definition_en: Observe the development patterns of Chinese revolutionary history using dialectics, unifying affirmation and critique of revolutionary history, and extracting universally meaningful historical laws from concrete practices.
process_zh: 运用辩证法观察革命历史的发展脉络
统一对革命历史的肯定与批判
从具体实践中提炼历史规律
验证历史规律的普适性
process_en: Observe the developmental veins of revolutionary history using dialectics
Unify affirmation and critique of revolutionary history
Extract historical laws from concrete practices
Verify the universality of historical laws
modern_applications: 历史研究方法的辩证统一
对当代问题的历史透视

modes.domain_en: Practical Methods of the Mass Line
modes.definition_zh: 坚持以人民群众为根本出发点和归宿，通过广泛听取群众声音、联系群众实际，把群众的创造性转化为党的创造性。
modes.definition_en: Adhere to taking the masses as the fundamental starting point and return, widely hear the masses' voices and connect with their actual situations, transforming the masses' creativity into the Party's creativity.
process_zh: 深入开展调查研究
广泛收集群众意见和建议
联系群众实际情况分析问题
把群众的创造性转化为党的创造性
process_en: Conduct in-depth investigative research
Widely collect mass opinions and suggestions
Analyze problems by connecting with actual mass situations
Transform the masses' creativity into the Party's creativity
modern_applications: 基层治理的群众路线
发展问题的人民性分析

modes.domain_zh: 马克思主义理论的创新发展
modes.domain_en: Innovation and Development of Marxist Theory
modes.definition_zh: 在继承马克思主义基本理论的基础上，结合中国革命实践的新特点和新问题，进行创新性的理论构建和升华。
modes.definition_en: On the basis of inheriting the basic principles of Marxism, combined with new characteristics and problems in Chinese revolutionary practice, carry out innovative theoretical construction and elevation.
process_zh: 继承马克思主义基本理论
结合革命实践的新特点提出问题
进行创新性理论构建
理论升华和完善
process_en: Inherit basic principles of Marxism
Propose new questions combined with characteristics of revolutionary practice
Carry out innovative theoretical construction
Theoretical elevation and perfection
modern_applications: 当代马克思主义理论研究
创新性的政治理论构建

modes.definition_zh: 将理论转化为实践，通过具体的革命实践验证理论的正确性，并根据实践反馈不断优化和发展理论。
modes.definition_en: Transform theory into practice, verify the correctness of theory through concrete revolutionary practice, and continuously optimize and develop theory based on practice feedback.
process_zh: 将理论转化为具体的行动指南
通过革命实践验证理论的正确性
根据实践反馈不断优化和发展理论
形成具有行动指导意义的理论成果
process_en: Transform theory into concrete action guidelines
Verify the correctness of theory through revolutionary practice
Continuously optimize and develop theory based on practice feedback
Form theoretical outcomes with guiding significance for practice
modern_applications: 革命实践的科学方法
理论与实践的统一

modes.domain_zh: 统一战线的组织与协调
modes.domain_en: Organization and Coordination of the United Front
modes.definition_zh: 在复杂的国内外形势下，统各派别、各阶层的力量，团结一切可以团结的力量，对抗共同的敌人。
modes.definition_en: Under complex domestic and international situations, unite various factions and classes, unite all forces that can be united, and confront common enemies.
process_zh: 分析国内外形势找到统一的着力点
团结各派别、各阶层的力量
建立统一战线的组织机构
协调各方利益和需求
process_en: Analyze domestic and international situations to find points of unity
United various factions and classes
Establish united front organizational mechanisms
Coordinate various interests and needs
modern_applications: 复杂形势下的政治联盟建设
多元利益协调的政治方法

modes.domain_zh: 共产党员的思想修养与锻炼
modes.domain_en: Ideological Cultivation and Exercise for Communist Party Members
modes.definition_zh: 通过理论学习、实践锻炼和反思总结，提高共产党员的政治素质和党性修养，做到知行合一。
modes.definition_en: Through theoretical learning, practical exercise and reflective summary, improve the political quality and party spirit cultivation of Communist Party members, achieving unity of knowledge and action.
process_zh: 加强理论学习提高政治素质
通过实践锻炼检验学习成果
进行反思总结汲取经验教训
实现知情行动的统一
process_en: Strengthen theoretical learning to improve political quality
Verify learning outcomes through practical exercise
Conduct reflective summary to draw on experience and lessons
Achieve unity of knowledge and action
modern_applications: 党员教育的科学方法
党性修养的提升途径

modes.domain_zh: 革命历史的回顾与总结
modes.domain_en: Review and Summary of Revolutionary History
modes.definition_zh: 对过去的革命实践进行回顾和总结，从中提炼出宝贵的经验和教训，为后续的实践提供指导。
modes.definition_en: Review and summarize past revolutionary practices, extract valuable experiences and lessons therefrom, and provide guidance for subsequent practices.
process_zh: 系统梳理革命实践的发展历程
从实践中提炼关键经验
总结宝贵的教训和失败原因
为后续实践提供经验指导
process_en: Systematically review the developmental course of revolutionary practice
Extract key experiences from practice
Summarize valuable lessons and causes of failure
Provide experiential guidance for subsequent practice
modern_applications: 革命历史研究的科学方法
对当代问题的历史经验借鉴

modes.domain_zh: 中华优秀传统文化的现代转化
modes.domain_en: Modern Transformation of Excellent Chinese Traditional Culture
modes.definition_zh: 在继承和发扬中华优秀传统文化的基础上，增强文化自信，推动文化创新和发展。
modes.definition_en: On the basis of inheriting and carrying forward excellent traditional Chinese culture, enhance cultural confidence, and promote cultural innovation and development.
process_zh: 识别和挖掘中华优秀传统文化的核心价值
增强文化自信和文化认同
推动文化创新和现代化发展
促进文化的传承与创新
process_en: Identify and mine the core values of excellent traditional Chinese culture
Enhance cultural confidence and cultural identity
Promote cultural innovation and modernization development
Promote inheritance and innovation of culture
modern_applications: 文化创新发展的路径探索
文化自信的现代培育

modes.domain_zh: 多维度的革命实践评价
modes.definition_zh: 从政治、经济、文化、社会等多个维度对革命实践进行综合评价，形成系统的评价体系和结论。
modes.definition_en: Evaluate revolutionary practice from multiple dimensions such as politics, economy, culture, and society, forming a systematic evaluation system and conclusions.
process_zh: 确定评价的维度和指标体系
从政治经济文化社会等方面进行考察
综合分析评价结果
形成系统的评价结论和建议
process_en: Determine evaluation dimensions and indicator system
Conduct investigation and analysis from aspects of politics, economy, culture, society
Comprehensively analyze evaluation results
Form systematic evaluation conclusions and recommendations
modern_applications: 革命实践的综合评价
对当代问题多角度的评估

meta.source: 《邹文献文选》、中共史料、革命根据地档案
meta.methodology: 历史文献分析法、案例验证法、实践经验总结法
meta.validation: 与中国革命历史和实践交叉验证
